ownership_rule: User rule 2026-09-25: the project owns this database; no application (Ingest, Media Assist, Story or any other) owns it or its tables. No form writes to it, so none can own it: data made in an application reaches these tables only through the intermediary, the one public writer of the project database, qnc.module.content-store.
project_scope: The existing workspace DB URI resolves through its owner-provided binding. Its tables live in the project database, owned by the project; Project settings, registry, identity and activation are never writable through this adapter. No fallback project or second global clip catalog.
implementation_status: Select publication, persisted selection and startup/reload are connected through the public content adapter. Import execution is not implemented in this step.
storage_policy: Validate project identity before writes. Preserve existing WAL mode; otherwise use PERSIST rollback journals with short transactions and busy_timeout. Restore only required owner write permissions on validated output DB/journal directory, never remove delete ACLs or touch source card permissions.
public_record_policy: Accept a persisted metadata revision without running a new probe. Selection and import state are durable; media_records retains acquisition evidence.
single_clip_read: read(clip_id) returns one stored catalog/probe snapshot or null. Read-only, same Local/LAN/Intranet endpoint and identity validation. Schema remains 0.2.0; no migration or data rewrite. Peers must use the same transport contract version.
catalog_summary_read: list_summary returns paged lightweight catalog rows from materialized clip/source columns for UI startup. It must not deserialize catalog_json, probe_json, thumbnails or media snapshots. Full clip/probe payload is read only through read(clip_id) when a module actually needs it.
catalog_stats_read: stats returns only a lightweight catalog signature: clip_count, selected_count, revision_sum, max_revision and fingerprint. App activation may use it to decide whether the already displayed catalog is stale, but it must not replace Select and must not scan cards or run probe.

select_reconciliation.publish_batch: At most 16 records in one transaction; previews may precede commit, success may not
select_reconciliation.remove_missing: Explicit confirmed source absence only, scoped by identity and revision; retain queued, processing and imported records; never delete media or acquisition evidence
select_reconciliation.existing_marker: Transient view projection of membership in the DB before the current Select, not import status

imported_copy_rule: clips.imported_copy_of (original | proxy | NULL), added to an existing database by the owner on a read-write open: the imported file is a byte copy, made by the import, of that representation of the clip, so the saved record of that representation describes it and no new probe is run. The copy URI is qnc://<environment>[/<authority>]/source/project-<project_id>/file/<original|proxy>/<name>: the project folder of the machine read as a media source. NULL: the imported media is linked where it is (imported_media_uri is the original or proxy itself).
